subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A health teacher created a one-week sleep challenge.”?
options: Phones may be used only during the first and last thirty minutes of the event.
The students made a large map and put a mark on each place named on the bottles.
Students put their homework there every morning.
Students had to put phones away thirty minutes before bed and record how they felt in the morning.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Phones may be used only during the first and last thirty minutes of the event.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The students made a large map and put a mark on each place named on the bottles.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students put their homework there every morning.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Students had to put phones away thirty minutes before bed and record how they felt in the morning.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Students had to put phones away thirty minutes before bed and record how they felt in the morning.」，答案為「Students had to put phones away thirty minutes before bed and record how they felt in the morning.」。
